name: Yamaha TT-300 Record Player
author: AleixoAlonso

license.label: CC Attribution
license.requirements: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.

description:
Yamaha TT-300

Built between 1987 and 1994, this Yahama record player has sold thousands of units all throughout the world. Thanks to its sleek, timeless design, this retro device still looks great today.

This 3D model is broken up into multiple parts allowing you to fully animate all buttons, the player’s tone-arm, and the dust cover. All of these objects have constraints should you choose to use the .blend-file. This model is to scale and features PBR textures made with Substance Painter.

Note:

The folder within the ZIP-folder titled "Textures 4k" contains empty images due to file size. Simply replace them with the 4k textures that come with the download.

Download includes:

  • 2k & 4k PBR textures
  • .blend file
  • .fbx file
